Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
If Andre LeRoux is bleeding for more than one from Computer Hacking for example, and his bleed would be successful, then is there a timing window where he can use his own special on his own bleed to reduce his own bleed by 1 to increase his bleed by +2?

Andre LeRoux
Clan: Toreador (group 5)
Capacity: 3
Disciplines: aus
Camarilla: When a vampire you control would successfully bleed, you may reduce the bleed amount by 1 to give Andre +2 bleed this turn.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Yes, cardtext. The timing window is "when a vampire you control would successfully bleed". He fulfills the condition.

He doesn't even need the Computer Hacking to make it work:

Andre Leroux bleeds for 1. No block. The bleed would be successful since it's for 1 or more. Since the condition is met, he uses his special to modify the bleed amout: -1+2 (both decrease and increase are applied at the same time).
So final bleed amount is: 1 -1 + 2 = 2.

Prince of Paris, France

> Sambomb wrote:

No, for two reasons:

- the SH is not a vampire
- bleeding for 0 doesn't trigger the condition "would successfully bleed"
